title: ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF CHAIRMAN-cum-MANAGING DIRECTOR AND DIRECTORS IN PSPCL AND PSTCL Corrigendum 1 Corrigendum-2 English / Punjabi

source.name: Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL), Punjab

text:
KEY LINES:
With reference to the Public Notice dated 10.09.2024 for the
Patiala and Public Notice dated 18.09.2024 for the post of Director (Finance),
PSPCL, the last date of receipt of applications is hereby extended to
16.10.2024. For details log in to www.punjab.gov.in, www.pSpcl.in,

FULL TEXT:
GOVERNMENT OF PUNJAB
DEPARTMENT OF POWER
(ENERGY BRANCH)
CORRIGENDUM-1
With reference to the Public Notice dated 10.09.2024 for the
posts of Chairman-cum-Managing Director, Director (Commercial), Director
(Distribution), Director (HR) in the PSPCL &Director (Technical) in the PSTCL
Patiala and Public Notice dated 18.09.2024 for the post of Director (Finance),
PSPCL, the last date of receipt of applications is hereby extended to
16.10.2024. For details log in to www.punjab.gov.in, www.pSpcl.in,
www.pstcl.org and wwW.pserc.gov.in
Deputy Secretary
